subject.title: fix(voice-call): avoid OpenAI realtime double greeting

question: Should maintainers require live Twilio/OpenAI outbound-call proof before merging this OpenAI realtime greeting timing change, or explicitly accept source-harness proof for this PR?
rationale: The remaining blocker is affected-surface proof for live provider/carrier timing, which automation cannot supply from the contributor's setup and the maintainer label already routes this to human handling.

options.title: Require live outbound-call proof
options.body: Have the contributor or a maintainer run a redacted Twilio/OpenAI outbound call on the current head showing one initial greeting and normal post-greeting caller audio before merge.

options.title: Accept source-harness proof knowingly
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly accept the focused mocked regression proof while owning any live OpenAI/Twilio timing regression found after release.

options.title: Pause until credentials are available
options.body: Keep the PR open under maintainer handling until someone with the right OpenAI and telephony setup can prove the real provider path.

recommendation.title: Require live outbound-call proof
recommendation.body: Have the contributor or a maintainer run a redacted Twilio/OpenAI outbound call on the current head showing one initial greeting and normal post-greeting caller audio before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current PR assignee and the strongest available history owner for the touched OpenAI/voice-call realtime paths.
